## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` is clean
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes (engine and real-data tests skip without the siblings / data)
- [ ] `python scripts/repo_lint.py` passes (no file over 1 MB, no bidi control characters)
- [ ] Contracts unchanged, or a new ADR in `docs/adr/` explains the change
- [ ] Every new conclusion is written as a claim (source, method, reliability), never as a bare confidence
- [ ] If a published number changes: the result file was regenerated by `bench.yml`, README / docs updated, and a worse number is reported as worse
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` updated
- [ ] No datasets, credentials, exploit code or malware in the diff
